hero.text:
I'm fascinated by what happens when curiosity, creativity and technology come together.
I enjoy exploring new things, experimenting with my own ideas and turning rough concepts into something that actually works.

about.text:
I'm someone who likes to look behind the scenes, experiment with new things and bring my own ideas to life.
Web development, design and software projects are where I feel at home.
I enjoy diving into new technologies, exploring new ways of developing with AI and building solutions that are not only functional but also well thought out.

projects.text:
New projects and exciting ideas motivate me.
I quickly get up to speed with new topics, enjoy tackling different challenges and adapt easily to existing teams.

cards.title: Web Development
cards.text: JavaScript for interactive interfaces and dynamic applications, TypeScript for type-safe code, and PHP for server-side logic. Complemented by Python and Ruby for versatile web projects.

cards.title: Databases and Queries
cards.text: MariaDB and MySQL for structured data storage, management and retrieval. From relational data models to efficient SQL queries for custom applications.

cards.title: App Development
cards.text: Kotlin for modern Android applications and native app features. From the initial idea to building practical mobile applications of my own.

contact.text:
Have an idea or an exciting project in mind?
I'm always open to new challenges and connecting with other tech enthusiasts.
Feel free to reach out — I'd love to hear from you and see what we can build together.
